<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" xml:id="ex45012023-03-0115-56-03" type="excerpt" status="finalized"> <milestone unit="section" n="5. gzhan zla rnams rtsod du bkod pa'i tshe khyab ches kyi skyon yin par 'dod pa dgag pa"/>           
            lnga pa ni <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3839">brtson 'grus seng ge</rs> <app><lem wit="inst:5593">na re</lem><rdg wit="inst:5593">na re</rdg><rdg wit="inst:4770">na re ||</rdg></app> dkar zal mtshan gzhi ba lang gi tha snyad dkar zal kho na la yod par mtshon | nog shal laosgs 'dus pa dkar zla kho na la yod pa mtshan nyid du <lb edRef="inst:4770" n="17a4"/> bkod pa'i tshe | khyab ches nas mtshan gzhi la mi srid pa yin lo | gang la khyab ches <app><lem wit="inst:4770">nas</lem><rdg wit="inst:4770">nas</rdg><rdg wit="inst:5593">na</rdg></app> mtshan gzhi dkar <lb edRef="inst:5593" n="14a3"/> zal las gzhan nag sgyur la khyab ches pa yin zer ro ||</seg></TEI>
